mentions.name: Openreading
mentions.description: Openreading is a document intelligence router that routes documents to other parsers with key techniques for managing failures, based on the author's team's enterprise document intelligence experience. It is open core and work-in-progress, with benchmarks and a managed version (durable compute, retries, parallel execution, intent understanding) planned for later.
mentions.problem: Even with state-of-the-art OCR, SLMs, LLMs, and many parser services, most miss something in enterprise document intelligence, so failure handling has to be designed for.
mentions.audience: Building document pipelines for sensitive industries like healthcare, insurance, and lending where existing parsing services miss things and failures need to be managed.
mentions.source_excerpt:
We are bringing these ideas out as a router to other parsers, but with some key takes that allow you to manage failures. 
"Failure is inevitable so route for it."

It is called Openreading - https://openreading.ai/ and open core here: https://github.com/openreading-ai/openreading-core
mentions.author: c0mpute
